verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a public REST API with a token-based quickstart (vanta-docs-1). Its reference covers CRUD endpoints for controls, tests, contracts and business units, including rate limits and a FedRAMP server option. It also has a separate Auditor API with official type-safe SDKs generated from an OpenAPI spec, and the docs are agent-readable via llms.txt and .md pages, which probes confirmed. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, and no publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec at the common paths (probe returned 404).
